title: Two-speaker diarized: self-report vs provider account
purpose: Speaker 1 says 'I did it all by myself'; Speaker 0 says they did most of it. The draft must not record independence; dishes were only deferred.

plan.serviceDescription: Community Living Supports: household routines (synthetic plan)

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: Let's start the laundry, can you sort the darks from the lights?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I sorted them, the jeans go with the darks.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: I did most of the measuring and pressed start for you.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I did it all by myself.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: You loaded the machine; I handled the detergent and the settings.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Can we skip the dishes today?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0
transcript.text: Sure, we'll do the dishes next visit.
